bonus_ledger_shape.name: bonus_ledger_shape
bonus_ledger_shape.value:
("bonus_ledger"."source_kind" = 'manual' AND "bonus_ledger"."reverses_id" IS NULL AND "bonus_ledger"."request_hash" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("bonus_ledger"."source_kind" <> 'manual' AND "bonus_ledger"."request_hash" IS NULL
            AND ("bonus_ledger"."reverses_id" IS NOT NULL OR "bonus_ledger"."delta_points" > 0))

contents_deleted_payload.name: contents_deleted_payload
contents_deleted_payload.value: "contents"."status" <> 'deleted' OR ("contents"."title" IS NULL AND "contents"."body" IS NULL AND "contents"."tags" IS NULL)

contents_tags.name: contents_tags
contents_tags.value: "contents"."tags" IS NULL OR ("contents"."kind" IN ('question', 'material') AND json_valid("contents"."tags") AND json_type("contents"."tags") = 'array')

contents_shape.name: contents_shape
contents_shape.value:
("contents"."kind" IN ('material', 'question') AND ("contents"."title" IS NOT NULL OR "contents"."status" = 'deleted') AND "contents"."target_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("contents"."kind" IN ('answer', 'comment') AND "contents"."title" IS NULL AND "contents"."target_id" IS NOT NULL)

material_upload_sessions_result.name: material_upload_sessions_result
material_upload_sessions_result.value: ("material_upload_sessions"."status" = 'published') = ("material_upload_sessions"."result_version" IS NOT NULL) AND ("material_upload_sessions"."result_version" IS NULL OR "material_upload_sessions"."result_version" > 0)

material_upload_sessions_lease.name: material_upload_sessions_lease
material_upload_sessions_lease.value: ("material_upload_sessions"."status" = 'confirming') = ("material_upload_sessions"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "material_upload_sessions"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
